description: For deficiency notice, this checklist records nonconforming condition, required correction, protection measures, response deadline, and potential consequences. Its supporting evidence includes photos, test failures, inspection record, correspondence, specification excerpt, and prior notice history.

blocks.guidance: Link this deficiency notice record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture contract requirement, affected work, location, responsible party, discovery date, and related inspection for this deficiency notice.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Core Identifiers

sections.guidance: Identify contract requirement, affected work, location, responsible party, discovery date, and related inspection for this deficiency notice record.
sections.title: Checkpoint Reference

blocks.guidance: For deficiency notice, record nonconforming condition, required correction, protection measures, response deadline, and potential consequences.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Required Inputs

blocks.guidance: Verify the deficiency notice condition before marking.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Verification Points

blocks.guidance: Reconcile unchecked deficiency notice items before release.
items: Correct checklist version and applicability are confirmed
Prerequisite documents and access are available
Each item is marked verified, not applicable, or exception
Exceptions name an owner and target correction date
Final release is within the reviewer's authority
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Repeatable Checklist

blocks.guidance: Pair each deficiency notice result with a finding.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Checkpoint Result

blocks.guidance: Stop or protect affected work when continued activity could conceal, compound, or create unsafe deficiency. Do not release affected deficiency notice work.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Stop and Review Boundary

blocks.guidance: Close deficiency notice exceptions with verification.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Exception and Corrective Action

blocks.guidance: Keep deficiency notice controls until authorized release.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Escalation Record

blocks.guidance: State deficiency notice limits, assumptions, and access gaps.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Limitations and Interpretation

fields.label: Deficiency Notice Correction Verification and Release Notes

blocks.guidance: For deficiency notice, connect the correction to photos, test failures, inspection record, correspondence, specification excerpt, and prior notice history; name the release decision and retained deficiency notice limitation.
blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Correction Verification and Release Notes

sections.guidance: Verify deficiency notice conditions, control exceptions, and preserve release evidence.
sections.title: Checklist Conditions, Exception, and Release

blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Findings, Measurements, and Evidence

blocks.label: Deficiency Notice Evidence Sources

subtitle: Deficiency Notice Checklist: formal construction deficiency notice and cure tracking using contract requirement, nonconforming condition, and photos.
title: Deficiency Notice Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during formal construction deficiency notice and cure tracking when the deficiency notice record must identify contract requirement, affected work, location, responsible party, discovery date, and related inspection. Complete the applicable handoff for cure proposal, verified correction, cost or schedule reservation, acceptance, and notice closure.
